title: mojo-io task graph, version 1
description: Every Maven mojo execution of a build as a task: what it reads, what it writes, where its project-state record lives, and how projects depend on each other. Tool-agnostic. Paths use {projectRoot}, {workspaceRoot} and {localRepository} placeholders.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path that {workspaceRoot} stood for when the graph was written.

maven.description: Maven version that computed the graph.

goals.description: Goals/phases the graph was computed for.

granularity.description: How each project's executions are grouped into tasks (mojoio.graph.granularity).

lifecycle.description: Maven 4's default lifecycle: the phase tree with its links (read from Maven 4 at run time; a built-in copy of the Maven 4 default on Maven 3) and the Maven 3 -> Maven 4 phase aliases.

path.description: Project directory relative to the workspace root; "" for the root.

dependsOn.description: ids of reactor projects this one depends on directly (dependencies, parent, plugins).

poms.description: This project's pom and its ancestors inside the workspace.

dependencies.description: Direct reactor dependencies with their Maven scope, type and classifier: what the lifecycle's dependencies-links point at. One with a classifier (tests, sources, …) or a type other than a plain jar (test-jar, java-source, war, zip, …) only exists once the upstream project is packaged: it needs the upstream package task.

loadFiles.description: Files of this project that build extensions read while Maven loads it, before any mojo runs (from projectLoad declarations; Eclipse Tycho reads MANIFEST.MF, feature.xml, target definitions...). A build system that runs a task in a sandbox provides those of the task's project and of its reactorReferences.

configurationReferences.description: Reactor projects named by coordinates in this project's plugin configuration (a Tycho target definition, a build-tools module). Every task of this project depends on all of their tasks.

reactorReferences.description: Every reactor project a task of this project needs, transitively: dependencies, including those added while loading the project (Eclipse Tycho adds required bundles, features and units), and configuration references. Maven's "-am" can miss them: add them to "-pl".

tasks.description: Ready-made tasks for build systems, in execution order.

externalDependencies.description: Non-reactor dependencies, collected without resolving files: groupId:artifactId:type[:classifier]:version:scope.

name.description: By granularity. phase: runTogether group, else canonicalPhase. stage: compile, test, package, verify, install, deploy (else as phase). module: build.

lifecyclePhase.description: First phase of the Maven 4 tree the task covers.

lifecyclePhases.description: Every phase of the Maven 4 tree the task covers, in order.

executions.description: Execution ids, in order; run them in one invocation.

dependsOn.description: Task ids: the previous task of the project, and per dependencies-link of each of the task's phases, the last task of each matching reactor dependency with work the link's phase covers; and the "ready" task of each reactor dependency in a scope one of its mojos resolves.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase, null for goals invoked directly.

pluginReactorDependencies.description: Reactor projects the mojo's plugin is made of (the plugin itself or its dependencies): needed packaged before the mojo runs.

aggregator.description: An aggregator mojo. Invoked as a goal, Maven runs it once, for the build's top-level project, whatever project it is bound in.

requiresDependencyResolution.description: Scope of the project dependencies Maven resolves before the mojo runs (compile, runtime, test, …); the reactor dependencies in it must have been built.

invocation.description: Runs exactly this execution when passed to mvn as a goal (groupId:artifactId:version:goal@executionId).

lifecyclePhase.description: The Maven 4 lifecycle tree phase the execution belongs to (hooks and Maven 3 aliases resolved).

canonicalPhase.description: The Maven 3 name of the phase (Maven 4 reports hooks, e.g. after:resources = process-resources); identical across Maven versions.

runTogether.description: Executions sharing this value (a phase and its pre-/post- or before:/after: hooks) must run in one Maven invocation: hooks hold process-local state such as a started server.

fingerprint.description: Hash of what a build system cannot hash itself: plugin coordinates and dependencies, goal, JDK, evaluated configuration and value inputs. Includes stamp values. Null when not cacheable.

declaredBy.description: Source of the plugin-io declaration (project file, plugin jar, built-in), null if undeclared.

reason.description: Why the execution is not cacheable.

ignoredWrites.description: Ant patterns, relative to the project build directory, of bookkeeping files the execution or Maven writes (e.g. maven-status/**, maven-archiver/**, consumer-*.pom). Not outputs; exclude them from observed outputs.

stateFile.description: Where the execution's project-state record is written (mojo-io-state format). Restore it with the outputs.

paths.description: files: files or directories; under a directory only includes/excludes are selected.

scope.description: classpath: Maven resolution scope (compile, test, runtime, ...). The classpath consists of the outputs of the dependsOn projects plus external dependencies of that scope.

value.description: value: the value as known when the graph was computed.

path.description: A file, or a directory narrowed by includes/excludes.

observed.description: Known only after the run: the exact files are listed as `output` records in the stateFile.
